name: ipynb-mcp
description: MCP server (stdio) for AI agents to safely read, edit and run local Jupyter notebooks — zero service, CAS-guarded edits, resumable execution.

scripts.lint: oxlint src tests && node scripts/check-format.mjs && node scripts/check-indent.mjs && node scripts/check-docs.mjs --selftest && node scripts/check-docs.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run check:package
